reasons: Admitted on the vendor's own fetched documentation; this application has not run a live key gate against this endpoint.
The vendor's OpenAI-dialect reasoning replay contract must not be assumed for Anthropic Messages without a dialect-specific document or probe.

supported.sourceRef: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/protocols/messages — Muse Spark always reasons; output_config.effort low/medium/high/xhigh; redacted_thinking encrypted blob can be replayed

continuationDomain.sourceRef: BOTH halves. Own-state acceptance: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/protocols/messages (read 2026-10-29): assistant replay accepts "thinking / redacted_thinking: prior reasoning. `redacted_thinking` carries the encrypted blob; replay it to preserve chain of thought"; response "reasoning maps to `thinking` (`encrypted_content` maps to `redacted_thinking`)". The Anthropic adapter replays both block types verbatim on the producing model's next request. Why the domain is NARROW: the state is valid only for the model that produced it on this route -- a different model, or the same model at another provider (a different credential and account), never receives it, and the history renderer strips it there.
